Introduction {.unnumbered}
==========================

Confoederatio, Research Division (CRD) working papers are typeset in a single-column layout using **Jost\*** for headers and **Source Serif 4** for body prose, with numerical MLA inline citations per clause [@belkin2002using; @berard1994embedding] and at sentence ends [@coifman2005geometric].
